guideIntro: A clean putt begins with a complete read of the hole. Use the overview camera to find the safest line, then set only enough power to reach the intended landing zone.
steps: Switch to Overview to inspect ramps, water, moving windmills, loops, and bumper angles.
Drag back from the ball to set both direction and power, then release to take the shot.
Aim for a safe landing area when a direct line to the cup crosses a major hazard.
Use Follow view to judge the result and remember how the same power behaves on that surface.
Restart quickly when testing a hole-in-one line, then use Endless mode to extend a strong run.
